patch_description:
This version keeps the successful unequal-radius nonlinear optimization approach, while improving its efficiency and robustness through an analytic constraint Jacobian. The optimizer no longer has to numerically approximate derivatives for 429 pairwise and boundary constraints, allowing more reproducible multistart attempts within the time budget.

The construction uses the prior five-layer 26-site layout, adds staggered/asymmetric perturbation seeds to better explore boundary-adapted packings, retains the best feasible result, and applies a final global feasibility certificate to eliminate floating-point overlap or wall violations.
